questions.title: Python Data Types and Mutability
questions.description: Which of the following Python data types are mutable? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Mutable data types in Python can be modified after creation. Lists, dictionaries, and sets are mutable. Tuples, strings, and integers are immutable.

questions.title: Algorithm Time Complexity
questions.description: What is the time complexity of binary search algorithm on a sorted array of n elements?
questions.explanation: Binary search has O(log n) time complexity because it eliminates half of the remaining elements in each iteration, leading to logarithmic behavior.
